pattern: Desktop editor with focused working region, utility rails, time-based workspace and embedded AI entry

observed.hierarchy: Central preview is the darkest/largest shape, anchoring the visual focal point; left and right utility panes remain light and secondary.
observed.layout: Compact top toolbar, narrow media rail at left, central preview, inspector at right, timeline at bottom, AI composer in lower-right.
observed.tone: Almost monochromatic surfaces, subtle separators, modest icons and typography instead of decorative gradients.
observed.density: Workspace is highly structured but the empty project uses real contextual empty states, not arbitrary demo content.
observed.motion: Not observable from the static screenshot. Do not infer animations or actual working interactions.

transferToSurfaceLive: Treat the generated running application as the main subject; place AI input, selection, inspector and export controls around it with quieter visual weight.
doNotCopy: Do not copy OpenFilm's exact pane measurements, glyphs, branding or editing workflow; SurfaceLive is a frontend authoring tool, not a film editor.
